purpose: Execute the unchanged dynamic-fanout mission after universal compiled-controller-plan dispatch repair.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python canonical/runtime/astra_runtime.py canonical/astra_runtime/missions/ASTRA_RUNTIME_LIVE_DYNAMIC_FANOUT_001.json
python - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/state/ASTRA-RUNTIME-LIVE-DYNAMIC-FANOUT-001.json')
x=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert x.get('status')=='COMPLETE', x
hist=x.get('history') or []
assert hist and (hist[-1].get('result') or {}).get('planning_mode')=='DETERMINISTIC_DYNAMIC_FANOUT_PLAN', hist
print('DYNAMIC_FANOUT_UNIVERSAL_DISPATCH_COMPLETE')
PY
